name: hold_umbrella
text: Standing comfortably under an umbrella held with the right hand beside the cheek, elbow down. The left arm hangs straight and relaxed beside the thigh.

scene.description: Start at level ground facing +Z. A person stands still holding the shaft of an open umbrella upright in their right hand just in front of the right shoulder at chest height.
